description: P2 CPU-only Wishbone scenario: the pinned PicoRV32 Wishbone master (picorv32_wb_irq_rvfi, real RVFI retirement) with one unified cyc/stb/we/adr/sel/dat network served by host RAM. picorv32 resets at PROGADDR_RESET=0 and has one memory port for both fetches and data, so the program address is 0 and there is no separate instruction channel. The CPU artifact is resolved from the profile on each invocation.
